summary: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot. Both models are designed for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.
takeaways: Both models are designed for agentic coding and code review, with stronger coding judgment than earlier GPT-6 models.
GPT-6.2 Astra: OpenAI’s latest Astra model for agentic coding and terminal work.
In early testing, it caught significantly more issues in code review than GPT-6 Astra and completed agentic coding tasks using noticeably fewer tokens.
